description: Trigger evaluation - tests whether the skill activates on appropriate prompts and stays silent on unrelated ones

evals.prompt: Write Appium tests for the myProlink login screen. It has email, password, and a login button. React Native app, needs to run on Android and iOS.
evals.rationale: Explicit Appium + mobile app + screen description - primary use case

evals.prompt: I need mobile test automation for our Flutter app's checkout flow. It runs on both platforms and we use Python for our test framework.
evals.rationale: Mobile automation + Flutter + Python - Appium covers Flutter apps

evals.prompt: Help me set up Appium on my machine. I have a Mac and want to test on Android emulator and iOS simulator.
My mobile tests keep failing with 'element not found'. The app is React Native and the accessibility IDs changed after the last release.
evals.rationale: Mobile test debugging with locator issues - Debug Flow

evals.prompt: Generate test cases for the onboarding carousel. User swipes through 4 screens, each has an image, title, and description. Last screen has a Get Started button.
How do I run my Appium tests on BrowserStack? I need to test on Samsung Galaxy S23 and Pixel 8.
evals.rationale: Device cloud integration - Cloud Integration Flow

evals.prompt: Write a Maestro flow for the signup screen. YAML-based, should cover happy path and validation errors.
evals.rationale: Maestro is a different skill (maestro-flow-tester), not Appium

evals.prompt: Write XCUITest cases in Swift for the iOS settings screen.
evals.rationale: XCUITest with Swift is a native iOS skill, not Appium

evals.prompt: Write Playwright tests for the admin dashboard web app. It's a Next.js application.
evals.rationale: Web testing with Playwright, not mobile

evals.prompt: Run a load test against the mobile API with 500 concurrent users.
evals.rationale: Load/performance testing, not mobile UI automation

evals.prompt: I need to test our native Android Kotlin app. Can you generate test automation for the product listing screen?
evals.rationale: Native Android app testing - Appium covers native apps too

evals.prompt: Write mobile regression tests for the search feature. User types a query, sees results, taps a result to view details. React Native.
evals.rationale: Mobile regression + screen flow + React Native

evals.prompt: How do I find element locators for a React Native app? The devs haven't added testIDs yet.
evals.rationale: Mobile locator strategy question - core Appium concept

evals.prompt: Write Espresso tests in Kotlin for the Android payment screen.
evals.rationale: Espresso + Kotlin is a separate skill

evals.prompt: Generate API contract tests for the user service endpoints using Python.
evals.rationale: API testing, not mobile UI automation
